description: The plot illustrates relative change (in percent) across groups of model layers for several KV-cache token/precision configurations, with a dashed baseline reference. The x-axis is labeled with five categorical layer ranges—“Layer1-4,” “Layer5-12,” “Layer13-20,” “Layer21-28,” and “Layer29-32”—spaced evenly as discrete categories. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” on a linear scale, ranging from about −25% up to 5%, with labeled ticks at 5%, 0%, −5%, −15%, and −25%. A gray dashed horizontal line labeled “Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit” lies at 0% across all layer groups. The gold solid line with circular markers (“LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit”) stays close to 0%, starting near 0% at Layer1-4, dipping to around −1% to −2% at Layer13-20, and returning to approximately 0% by Layer29-32. The red solid line with square markers (“LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit”) begins around 0% at Layer1-4, declines to roughly −1% at Layer5-12 and about −4% to −5% at Layer13-20, then rises to around −1% at Layer21-28 and ends near 0% at Layer29-32. The teal solid line with circular markers (“RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit”) starts near −2% at Layer1-4, is around −2% to −3% at Layer5-12, drops to roughly −13% at Layer13-20, then increases to about −2% at Layer21-28 and finishes near −1% to −2% at Layer29-32. The dark blue solid line with square markers (“RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit”) begins around −3% at Layer1-4, is near −4% at Layer5-12, reaches its lowest point around −25% at Layer13-20, then rises to about −5% to −6% at Layer21-28 and ends near −3% to −4% at Layer29-32.
